clips.title: The story
paras: A Simmering Storm begins when an adventurer recovers a strange, spark-emitting relic known as the Dull Stormy Orb from the harpies of Drygulch Ravine. Bearing the swirling miniature storm to the goblin tinker Rezlak provides insight into the harpies' odd trinkets and earns the interest of Ratchet's enterprising salvagers.

While contending with the aggressive Dustwind harpies nesting throughout Drygulch Ravine, travelers may come across an unusual curiosity: the Dull Stormy Orb. Though its outer surface appears muted and worn, holding the object reveals a steady vibration of raw electrical current. Inside the sphere, dark mist churns endlessly, illuminated at random intervals by sharp internal sparks. It is unmistakable proof that the harpies were manipulating storm magic through strange relics.

Rather than leaving such volatile magic in the talons of wild harpies, the orb can be brought directly to Rezlak. Stationed at the entrance of Drygulch Ravine, the pragmatic goblin tinker takes an immediate interest in the strange relic, noting that its discovery recalls old advice from his employer in Ratchet, Chief Engineer Gazlowe. Whatever the harpies intended to brew with the miniature storm, it now sits in goblin hands.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Before you is a strange orb with a dull surface. When picked up a small electrical current seems to vibrate from within. Upon closer inspection, it looks as if a dark mist swirls within and every so often a small electrical spark can be seen.
It is clear the harpy was using it for some purpose. Perhaps Rezlak would be interested in this object?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Woah, where did you find a neat thing like that? Ya know it reminds me of the other thing my boss Gazlowe always used to tell me...
